run_nms: run non-maximum suppression on bounding boxes and scores with an IoU threshold to filter overlapping detections
run_soft_nms: run soft NMS on bounding boxes using linear or gaussian score decay method to suppress overlapping detections
run_batched_nms: run batched NMS on multi-class bounding boxes with per-class suppression and optional splitting for large batches
run_nms_match: run NMS match to group suppressed bounding boxes with their keeping box into matched groups by score order
run_nms_rotated: run NMS on rotated bounding boxes in center width height angle format with optional clockwise flag
